# zlib / checksum_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `checksum_fuzzer` ([source](source/checksum_fuzzer.c), unmodified) over zlib 1.3.1 (madler/zlib at 51b7f2ab).

Checks 6 properties (listed below); the first, an algebraic law: CRC-32 combine law, per chunk (chunk size = data[0], min 1): crc32_combine_op(crc_so_far, crc32(0,chunk), crc32_combine_gen(chunk_len)) must equal crc32_z(crc_so_far, chunk).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against zlib 1.3.1 at commit 51b7f2ab.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- CRC-32 combine law, per chunk (chunk size = data[0], min 1): crc32_combine_op(crc_so_far, crc32(0,chunk), crc32_combine_gen(chunk_len)) must equal crc32_z(crc_so_far, chunk) ([lines 33-38](source/checksum_fuzzer.c#L33-L38)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.
- Chunked crc32_z over the whole input (chunk size data[0]) must equal the one-shot crc32(0, data, len) ([lines 39-43](source/checksum_fuzzer.c#L39-L43)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.
- crc32_combine(crc1,crc2,len)==crc32_combine(crc1,crc1,len) and crc32_combine_op(crc1,crc2,op)==crc32_combine_op(crc2,crc1,op): trivially true, since crc1 == crc2 was just asserted ([lines 44-50](source/checksum_fuzzer.c#L44-L50)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.
- crc32_combine(crc1, crc2, len) must equal crc32_combine_op(crc2, crc1, crc32_combine_gen(len)): the two combine APIs agree (operands swapped, but equal by the previous assert) ([lines 47-52](source/checksum_fuzzer.c#L47-L52)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.
- Chunked adler32_z over the input must equal the one-shot adler32(1, data, len) ([lines 55-61](source/checksum_fuzzer.c#L55-L61)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.
- adler32_combine(adler1, adler2, len) == adler32_combine(adler1, adler1, len): trivially true, since adler1 == adler2 was just asserted ([lines 62-63](source/checksum_fuzzer.c#L62-L63)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies them on every input it covers.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch zlib` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `checksum_fuzzer.plain` | 52,880 | `4f04e95082d3e0baa9d55c72288945d99e64bb7503e39c0e644f4b38a7781af2` |
| ubsan | `checksum_fuzzer.ubsan` | 53,520 | `5e80c9b8ebfbbfc3d24e8cc2d4e15d4e1780e758982b2305b85cbf61981fcd63` |
| asan | `checksum_fuzzer.asan` | 571,640 | `60b2389f5b431e1dcd8da721010b42685da22e709d0caf41422eebcccf43084a` |
| asan-ubsan | `checksum_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 571,896 | `dcce41d931b687f7ca2c8fae8b61748ae6e7d870e849ee2b91bb669b7e02d47c` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
